title: kate-search: search a list of files
summary: search_files runs search_file over the paths in order, collects the hits up to a limit, and collects the errors instead of stopping. The pane shows the hits and counts the skipped files.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The crate is pure Rust and builds anywhere. The backlog marks this title LOCAL so the Mac lane keeps the panes and their models together.

definitions.definition:
/// Hits in path order, at most `limit`, and the errors of the files that were skipped.
pub fn search_files(paths: &[std::path::PathBuf], query: &SearchQuery, limit: usize) -> (Vec<FileHit>, Vec<FileSearchError>)

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Stop reading more files when the hits reach limit. Export search_files from lib.rs. The test search_files_collects_hits_and_errors writes two temp files with one hit each and lists a missing path between them, asserts two hits and one Io error, and that limit 1 gives one hit. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: files::tests::search_files_collects_hits_and_errors
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because search_files does not exist. After the change the hits of readable files are collected, a missing file is an error, and the limit stops the walk.
